status: Connected-passage and rigid-motion candidate validated against frozen1101-occurrence assembly; ready for replacement integration

source_entries.title: Ford FS10 inter-head passages and comparison cylinder/valve photographs
source_entries.review: Ford explicitly describes gas-tight passages through the cylinder connecting both heads to rear suction/discharge ports. This supports connectivity, not the number, location or section of this candidate's drilled galleries. Later FS10-family evidence is not 1994 truck dimensional evidence.

photos.review: Visually inspected five cylinder openings, peripheral passage spaces and inner openings. No photo scaling or positive suction/discharge assignment.
Visually inspected two five-bore blocks, case halves and separate valve/reed sheets. Construction comparison only.
Visually inspected full reed sheets and valve plates. Slots, holes, plenums and gasket profiles in the model are still assumed.

geometry_revision.unchanged_application_constraints: FS10 factory-A/C comparison branch, 145 mm clutch outside envelope, six grooves, selected 0.6 mm clutch gap; no verified installed unit identity or pitch diameter.
geometry_revision.rigid_cups: Two sphere centers are fixed on each piston axis at +/-3.2/cos(18deg) mm. Pistons and rings now only translate; hemispherical shoes rotate around their sphere centers. This removes the prior phase-dependent socket shape reconstruction.
geometry_revision.gallery_topology: Two assumed 4 mm diameter axial galleries at local (0,+59) and (0,-59) connect both heads. Each head cap contains assumed radial and axial drillings reaching its assigned concentric plenum without crossing the other. Local Z is the shaft direction before rotation to global X.
geometry_revision.face_sealing: Full-sheet U-slotted suction and discharge reeds meet the cylinder and valve faces. Expanded outer and divider gasket envelopes meet head faces. The mid-case gasket contains gallery and bolt openings. Exact production gasket profiles and leakage performance are not claimed.
geometry_revision.grooves: Shared accessory_belt_profile.regroove_x repairs the old rectangular groove band and applies six centered 3.56 mm-pitch, 40-degree V grooves, depth3.45 mm. These are Optibelt PK comparison constraints, not a traced Ford pulley.

motion_contract.integration: Replace the baseline ac_compressor.build call with ac_compressor_motion.build((define,add,group)); do not call both. Existing61definition/occurrenceIDs remain unchanged.
motion_contract.descriptor: type=fs10; role=pulley|shaft|piston|shoe; piston/shoe descriptors carry cylinder_phase_deg and stroke_amplitude_mm.
motion_contract.controls: Independent compressor_degrees and compressor_engaged. No crank-angle or belt-speed ratio. Disengaged pulley still follows independent angle, while shaft/pistons/shoes reset to the reference pose.
motion_contract.translation: A*(cos(theta)-cos(theta-phase)) along global X, where A=37*tan(18deg).
motion_contract.rotation: Shaft/pulley rotate around local X at the compressor origin. Each shoe group is based at its phase-zero ball center; translation then X rotation acts about that center. Piston groups translate without rotating.
motion_contract.clutch_limit: Engagement is a teaching control, not a transient clutch simulation. The combined armature/hub is not translated and its static air gap is not closed.
motion_contract.explode: Front/rear head, reed, plate and cylinder stacks separate axially by role; pistons and shoes separate radially; clutch pieces separate individually toward the front. Explode is not an assembly procedure.

flow_check_scope.positive: Two connected reduced-radius probe volumes link rear ports to both assigned head plenums without occupying any modeled part or intersecting each other.
flow_check_scope.negative: Twenty small probes cross the ten suction and ten discharge windows. Each intersects only its assigned seated reed; clearing that reed window leaves the selected route open. This does not prescribe actual reed lift or deformation.
flow_check_scope.limit: These are selected geometric connectivity/obstruction checks, not an exhaustive void flood-fill or pressure simulation. Running clearances, oil films, pressure-actuated reed bending and refrigerant properties remain unresolved.
